text:
Aisha - Content: Quick sync — we need a single-sheet 'enterprise deployment playbook' for the webinar landing + SDR warroom. It should cover: 1-line positioning, one-pager download, 2 short social posts, benchmark blurb, and routing instructions for incoming leads.

Tom - PMM: Yes. Keep copy modular so SDRs can copy snippets. Two social angles: security-first (for compliance buyers) and cost/latency (for platform buyers). Add a small badge: 'SLA-ready' for Dedicated.

Riley - Solutions Eng: Add a tiny diagram text: "API -> Dedicated pool (SLA) -> Private (VPC/HSM)" and a note: "KMS: bring-your-own supported; HSM via partner integrations". For regulated customers, include 'time-to-demo' estimates: Private: 4-8 weeks, Dedicated trial: 3-10 days, Hosted: immediate.

Priya - AE: For inbound routing please map intent -> owner -> play. My suggestion:
- "compliance/legal" -> AE + Solutions Eng + Security briefing (tag: enterprise:security)
- "pilot/proof" -> SDR -> Solutions Eng -> Dedicated trial (tag: enterprise:pilot)
- "volume/ops" -> AE + Platform lead (tag: enterprise:scale)
Also add 3 qualifying Qs for SDRs: 1) Is data residency required? 2) Expected QPS or tokens/day? 3) Any regulator constraints (HIPAA, FedRAMP)?

Diego - Product: Benchmark blurb: keep it tight — "95th-pctl latency (1k token gen, 512 context): Hosted ~130ms | Dedicated ~85ms | Private depends on infra (80-200ms). Cost (approx /1M tokens): Hosted $A | Dedicated (amortized) $B | Private: variable." Add method note: "Internal synthetic harness; median of multiple runs; batching and quantization change results." Please mark numbers as placeholders until I drop final values.

Aisha - Content: For the one-pager tone: short bullets, callouts for "Why this matters for security teams" and "Why this matters for platform teams". Provide two ready-to-copy LinkedIn posts: 140-char security post + 140-char performance/cost post. Include CTA: "Download the playbook | Schedule a security briefing".

Tom - PMM: Webinar plan: 30-min tech demo + 15-min customer Q&A. Speakers: Diego (product), Riley (solutions), and a customer panel (ask Sophie from Acme?). Landing page should include 1-pager download gated by email + HubSpot hidden fields: hs_context, lead_source=webinar, campaign=enterprise-deploy-playbook.

Priya - AE: SDR script snippet for routing: "Thanks — quick q: are you evaluating for regulated data or internal platform scale? If regulated, we'll schedule a security briefing with Solutions. If platform, we can set a Dedicated trial and a 30-min demo." Keep it <2 lines.

Riley - Solutions Eng: Compliance table suggestion (inline text rows): SOC2: Yes; ISO27001: Limited (contact PM); FedRAMP: Contact PM; Data residency: Regional regions supported (contact for details). Add a note: "Customer-managed keys available for Dedicated + Private."

Diego - Product: Also add a short section on fallbacks: "If Dedicated capacity constrained, automatic routing to Hosted is available (policy controlled). Canary and A/B rollout options supported for Dedicated and Private."

LegalBot: Reminder — any claim about SLA or specific metrics must be approved. Please submit the final collateral to legal@redwood at least 72 hours before publish.

Aisha - Content: I'll draft the one-pager and two social variants today, put them in Notion, and mark product numbers as TBD. Tom, please confirm webinar speakers and customer panel. Priya, Riley: can you validate the SDR routing/qual questions?

Priya - AE: Confirmed on routing and questions. I'll provide HubSpot tag list: enterprise:security, enterprise:pilot, enterprise:scale.

Tom - PMM: I'll own the webinar registration flow + email cadence (reminder at 48h, 1h). Will also prepare a short benchmark slide for the deck with the methodology note.

Riley - Solutions Eng: I'll prepare the mini network diagram + KMS wording and check the 'time-to-demo' estimates with infra ops.

Aisha - Content: Great. Target timeline: draft one-pager by EOD, Notion link in 6h, legal submission after final numbers. Launch window: webinar + outbound next Wed.

(threads end)
